If the app only shows “Open a new account” and no option to “Link” or “Add” an existing savings, that usually means this online profile currently has no active savings attached to it.

Since you’re sure you opened a savings years ago, a few likely possibilities are:
- The savings is linked to a different online profile (different email/username or older login).
- The savings account was closed or made dormant/inactive and removed from online view.
- There’s a back‑end linking issue on the bank’s side.

Here’s how to pin this down quickly:

1. Check for another login
- Think about whether you ever:
  - Changed your email or username with the bank, or
  - Had online banking before a redesign or merger.
- If there’s any chance, try signing out and:
  - Tap “Forgot username/password” using your older email/phone to see if another profile exists.

2. Check account status with support
From inside the app:
- Go to: Support / Help → Chat / Secure message / Call us.
- Use wording like:
  - “I opened a savings account with you years ago but I only see a checking account in the app. Can you check if I still have a savings account in your system, and if so:
     1) what its status is (open/closed/dormant), and  
     2) whether it’s linked to this online profile associated with [your current email/phone]?”

If they confirm it’s:
- OPEN but not showing: ask them to “link my existing savings account to this online profile so it appears on my Accounts screen.”
- DORMANT: ask, “What do I need to do to reactivate it and get it visible in the app?”
- CLOSED: there won’t be a current balance; you can ask for a past statement if you need historical info.

If you share what support tells you about the savings status (open, dormant, or closed), I can help you interpret it and figure out next steps.</action>
